title: Recover full caller sources and classify source-loading edges
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Recover exact full-caller and project-source evidence omitted from PR6553's deliberately limited 21-body pool. All 22 missing receiver bodies and six pinned project bodies match independent retained pins; the full 52680-byte Group01 driver is recovered separately. The original caller creates an authority object, constructs ParentEpoch with it, and passes the same epoch/authority to make_parent. Availability is established; current runtime authority is not.

Classify all 88 coarse scanner sites against exact AST anchors. They include stages of five source-loading pipelines, DATA/code-identity/dictionary operations and receiver/epoch/native interfaces. They are not 88 missing Python bodies. Preserve frozen predecessor records and add current-gap reconciliation.

**Joined prerequisite remains HOLD:** exact logical owner `run_controls_v1` is unresolved (one source identity remains unresolved). Twenty mandatory stage payload bodies remain unread future inputs; concrete separate normal/optimized plan/session bindings and original qualification remain open. No κ or original activity credit.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessor: [PR #6553](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6553).

Explicit user assignment: resolve source prerequisites for compiler-input closure and the bootstrap-control campaign; canonical [PR6321 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321#issuecomment-6592212681). Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; head `341824ce9d7cb46d1abb3f8624313f328a167e50`, tree `cfc331bcab74d72ca3afd7a7f1e4fd24b68cba3f`. All 64 files (2,167,393 bytes) were verified against the exact frozen blobs and regular-file modes.

Scope refined from [PR6553](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6553) head`2906d561f6fc5f68ba8f3863edfb91e2f63c8a43`: missing from a small pool was not global unavailability. [PR6370](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6370) `e144f3b0a440fd33efdcfa4e0bd1af059dfd4fb3` inner graph scope is unchanged; [PR6377](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6377) `2a26450dea25d7648b585befce5ed375857a8f90` selected parent/domain/closure remain fixed. Related 6374/6373/6371 are conditional prefix preparation/caller/entry, not full completion; 6397 preserves the exact direct two-build variant domain; 6549 remains conditional auxiliary guard evidence. Fresh implicated heads and bounded all-state function-name searches were checked; no global novelty/absence claim is made.

Outer orchestration closure's 57-module/five-argument interface is distinct from the 33-module parent and 36-module replay subsets, each with its own 48-module limit. The interim alias/signature obstruction was corrected. Older replay pins still need source-grounded compatibility; no blind repin or phase deletion.

## Validation

Independent GPT-6.1-sol Max source/identity review accepts 57 recovery-freeze files, 29 recovered source rows/copies, 174 permitted text installation rows and 88 exact AST anchors. Source originals are inert text; no original import/extracted call, compiler/native/decoder/target inspection, acquisition/decompression or original control rerun occurred.

The 20 unread inputs are three canonical gzip records plus seventeen upstream source/document artifacts. Their metadata is preserved; noninspection is not proof of global absence or native/binary type. The canonical owner/bootstrap qualification record and unchanged rubric were located/hash verified; actual manual financial meter and manual owner, currentness, real IO/EX and both profiles remain open. No hypothetical extra checklist is introduced.

This is an unregistered source archive; no VERIFY/TASK replay is added. Hosted planning cannot establish scientific correctness. Source round closed 10:44:45 UTC before 10:49:32 fixed stop; no automatic extension. Canonical policy 94.550533479 s; latest supplemental 115.890533479 s includes a separately measured 2-second constructor-fixture debit. Full physical/source/Pro/agent/review/publication/final costsOPEN_NOT_ZERO.

Supply required payload inputs and distinct actual mode plans before complete original stage construction. Runtime admission, C07 lifetime, complete compiler-input closure and the full bootstrap-control campaign remain unqualified. This source recovery does not establish their completion. App goal remains separately paused; no merge, schedule or service mutation.
